name: CRM
description: The CRM library app (forge 40d): companies, contacts, pipelines with their stages, deals moving through them, activities on their timelines and saved views, with the Sales rep and Sales manager roles and the tools chat and agents use. Forge's CRM app (40e) requires it for its pages; Invoicing, Support, the Nexus and Forms use its companies and contacts.

commands.title: Move a deal to a stage
commands.description: Moves the target deal to a stage of its pipeline, between two deals of that column (at its end when neither is given), and logs the move as an activity in the same commit: args {stage, after?, before?}

commands.title: Accept a proposed deal
commands.description: Makes the target proposed deal active

commands.title: Make a pipeline
commands.description: Makes a pipeline at the target id with its stages (Lead, Qualified, Proposal, Won and Lost when none are given): args {name, default?, stages?}; Sales managers only

commands.title: Reassign a record
commands.description: Gives the target company, contact, deal or activity a new owner: args {entity, owner}; Sales managers only

queries.name: pipelineDeals
queries.description: A pipeline's stages in order with their active deals, for the board: params {pipeline}

queries.name: timeline
queries.description: The activities on a contact, company or deal, newest first: params {contact?, company?, deal?}

queries.name: pipelineTotals
queries.description: Count, total and weighted amount of a pipeline's active deals per stage or owner: params {pipeline, groupBy}

roles.title: Sales manager
roles.description: Uses the CRM, changes every company, contact, deal and activity, reassigns them (record.reassign) and makes pipelines

roles.title: Sales rep
roles.description: Uses the CRM: reads every record, and changes the companies, contacts, deals and activities they own and shared ones with no owner

tools.name: findContact
tools.title: Find a contact
tools.description: Finds contacts by email (exact) or name (a part of it), each with its company and its open deals

tools.name: logActivity
tools.title: Log an activity
tools.description: Logs a call, email, meeting, note or message on a contact, company or deal, owned by the caller

tools.name: createDeal
tools.title: Create a deal
tools.description: Makes a deal owned by the caller in a pipeline and stage (the default pipeline's first open stage when left out); a proposal when propose is set or the calling agent's autonomy is suggest

tools.name: updateDeal
tools.title: Update a deal
tools.description: Changes a deal's name, amount, close date, probability, company or contacts

tools.name: moveDeal
tools.title: Move a deal
tools.description: Moves a deal to another stage of its pipeline, logging the move

tools.name: importContacts
tools.title: Import contacts
tools.description: Imports up to 500 contacts as one batch, matched on email, so importing again updates them

tools.name: agentOptions
tools.title: Agent options
tools.description: What the CRM gives agents: its tools and what each does, its records, proposals and how an agent gets access
